name: Vic McGowan
researchKeywords: political economy of health, structural inequalities, place and health, coastal communities
bio: Vic McGowan is a medical anthropologist and interdisciplinary social scientist working across applied public health, anthropology and health geography. She studies health inequalities as structural violence and a matter of social justice.
researchFocus: Vic examines the political economy of health inequalities and the structural processes that drive differences in health outcomes between places. She recently completed ethnographic research across four English coastal towns as part of the Wellcome Trust-funded North South Health Divide project.
